LIST.summary: Lists all background tasks registered on the connected member with their state.
LIST.complexity: O(T) where T is the number of registered tasks.

reply_schema.description: The registered tasks, keyed by task name.

running.description: True if the task is executing right now.

finished.description: True if the task has stopped and will not run again.

started_at.description: Time the task was registered, in seconds since the epoch.

last_run.description: Time of the last completed run, in seconds since the epoch. 0 if the task has not run yet.
